repository.description: The repository section name in the .pypirc config file (default: pypi)

repository_url.description: The repository URL to upload to, overriding --repository

username.description: The username to authenticate with (e.g., __token__ for PyPI.org tokens)

password.description: The password or token to authenticate with

cert.description: Path to an alternate CA bundle

client_cert.description: Path to SSL client certificate (PEM format containing key and cert)

sign.description: Whether to sign files to upload using GPG

sign_with.description: GPG program used to sign uploads (default: gpg)

identity.description: GPG identity used to sign files

skip_existing.description: Continue uploading files if one already exists (PyPI.org only)

comment.description: Comment to include with the distribution file

non_interactive.description: Do not interactively prompt for username/password if required credentials are missing
